task: Restructure My Capstone page (/project) by separating document submissions to the dedicated Submissions page (/project/submissions), eliminating the 5,000px vertical scroll into 6 responsive, ergonomic tabs (Proposal Drafting, Capstone 1, Capstone 2, Capstone 3, Action Done Matrix, and Consultations) per /i-arrange, /i-clarify, and /i-critique.

quality_gate_battery.playwright_visual_audit: 9 screenshots captured across Light/Dark modes, Desktop (1440x900) & Mobile (390x844)

lessons_learned.lesson: Mixing document submission dropzones with capstone milestone tracking creates severe UI bloat, duplicate network requests (useProjectSubmissions), and cognitive fatigue. Submissions belong exclusively in the dedicated Submissions hub (/project/submissions), while My Capstone acts as the executive control tower for proposal drafting, Gantt milestones, and ADM verification.
lessons_learned.prevention: Ensure presenter components provide clear directional link banners pointing to the authoritative workflow page rather than duplicating upload controls and state-heavy dropzones across multiple views.
